 Own LLVM backend development for our custom accelerator ISA — instruction selection, register allocation, scheduling, and linker support across scalar, vector, and floating\-point pipelines.  What you'll do
   

  

* Own LLVM backend development for our custom accelerator ISA — instruction selection, register allocation, scheduling, and linker support across scalar, vector, and floating\-point pipelines.
* Use and develop AI\-assisted tool flows to accelerate compiler development and performance tuning.


 What we're looking for
   

  

* Exceptional abilities in LLVM backend internals (TableGen, instruction selection, scheduling, register allocation)

* (Optional) Custom\-ISA bring\-up, MLIR experience, GPU / accelerator backends, or linker / loader work
